interface: shogitter-engine-package-v1 / wasm-bindgen / usi-wasm-v1 in a dedicated Web Worker
complete_search_path: load package JS and WASM in one dedicated Worker; construct one UsiEngine; load the profile NNUE once; send usinewgame; send position startpos|sfen ... moves ... so repetition history is replayed; send go movetime 100; consume the returned legal bestmove
supported_host_classes: desktop Chromium, Firefox, or Safari with WebAssembly, ES modules, dedicated Workers, performance.now, and at least 1 GiB available memory for the engine Worker
supported_device_classes: x86_64 desktop CPU with WebAssembly SIMD128
arm64 desktop CPU with WebAssembly SIMD128
clock_policy: instant 0.1.13 wasm-bindgen monotonic performance.now clock; deadline begins immediately before search; poll every 256 alpha-beta or qsearch nodes; requested move time is 100 ms
cold_warm_protocol: Measure package/module instantiation plus NNUE load as a cold-load sample in a fresh Worker. Promotion games use one already-instantiated Worker and one already-loaded NNUE; send usinewgame before each game to clear the transposition table, then replay the complete position-and-moves history. Do not reload the module or NNUE between games.
